TITLE: PM Starmer will not set out a timetable to quit, says his deputy
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-18 06:36 GMT
AUTHOR: William James
SOURCE: Reuters

KEY QUOTES:
- David Lammy (Deputy PM) on Sky News: "There will be no timetable for departure"
- Lammy said he had spoken to the PM twice on Sunday
- Settles overnight reporting from ITV/Mail on Sunday/i Paper suggesting Starmer was weighing a departure announcement
